title: project.init plan
description: The project that would be created and the digest that authorizes creating it. Every document and every copied file is listed before anything is written, so a five-disk project is one decision rather than five.

project_id.description: Derived from the name, through the same conversion every derived id uses.

sources.description: Every source the project would register, in id order, each with the whole-file object derived from it.

object_id.description: The whole-file object. It carries a `range` selector covering the entire source rather than no selector at all, because an object without one verifies as unrecoverable.

location.description: The project-relative path recorded for this source, when one is. Absent when the source stays outside the root under `in_place`, in which case a local binding is written instead.

bound_locally.description: Whether this source needed a `.amiga-re/local.json` binding, which is true on this machine and nowhere else.

committed.description: Whether the plan was written. False for `prepare`.

written.description: Paths actually written, relative to the destination. Empty for `prepare`.
